[[File:Hsiri_Naigleb_Nailati.png|thumb|right|280px|''[[Hsiri]]'', ''[[Naigleb]]'' and ''Nailati'' freighters near the [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']].]]
'''''Nailati''''' was a group of 12 [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] that were employed by [[Airam Clans|Airam]] clan leader [[Ilay]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The freighters carried [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] and conscripts to the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Vengeance (Executor-class)/Legends|''Vengeance'']] as part of Ilay's deal with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. When Ilay was captured by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] she revealed this transaction and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] were [[Battle of Dega|sent]] in the [[Dega system/Legends|Dega system]] to disable the freighters containing conscripts and destroy the ones carrying warheads. Once the freighters carrying conscripts were disabled [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] from [[Rescue Group]] were sent to capture them and liberate the conscripts.

Despite the freighters being modified to fire a single missile at the Rebel B-wings and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] engaging the Rebel fighters, the operation was a success.
